Argentina's World Cup win celebrations spark Falklands flag controversy

Following Argentina's World Cup semi-final victory over England, some Argentine players and fans displayed a banner referencing the Falklands Islands, known as Las Malvinas in Argentina. This action has drawn attention due to the historical conflict over the islands. FIFA's code of conduct prohibits political displays within stadiums.
